conf.description: PKI CA + OCSP (CAC/PIV) ocsp-access / other: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: pki-ocsp / ocsp-access / other. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (IIS integration (iis.access data stream)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
